proposedEntry.name: dashboard-ux
proposedEntry.description: Guides dashboard design toward decision support rather than chart display, for operational monitoring, analytics/KPI overviews, executive/team-health views, and product admin home screens. Directs defining the primary questions the dashboard must answer, leading with status and exceptions over equal-weight widgets, using consistent time ranges/definitions/refresh expectations, supporting drill-down to detail and action, designing for overview vs investigation density, and personalizing by role when audiences differ. Verification checklist confirms users can identify what needs attention, metrics have clear definitions, and paths exist from insight to action.
